page.overview:
What is Indians?

Indians was a subtheme of Western, which features native Americans living in their environment, and has unique parts such as tepees, canoes, animals, and even special weapons. The subtheme started in 1997, the year when all of its proper sets were released. In 2002 and 2003, several other Indians products were released.
